coverage_limits: HTV recommendations are unknown unless explicitly verified below; dates and observed flow rates do not supply recommendation labels.
Only the eight listed Victorian districts have full distributions in this catalogue; Brunswick stops with three candidates and supplies no final Liberal-to-ALP/Greens transfer.
The 2019 and 2022 alternative-TPP tables are AEC-origin counts on a secondary publication; original PDF hashes are unavailable. They are separately identifiable.
For the 24 ZIP-based by-elections, the complete FP roster is reconstructed from the original-source table, including recipient own-FP rows; this is not an independent FP cross-check.
All included counts use CPV. Nicklin 2001 OPV, older federal distributions and other unparsed archives are not silently treated as additional original-source observations.
Matching district names across elections identify repeated geographic contexts, not unchanged electoral boundaries or independent jurisdictions.

quarantine_rules.reason: AEC identifies Bradfield notional TPP data as mathematically approximated; these supplemental source rows are not verified observed preferences.
